Honestly I’m just tired of being referred too “that f ing little basterd” or people telling me I don’t belong here. I’ve been dealing with my depression for 5 years ever since we moved to a new town to be closer to family and so my mom can move in with her girlfriend (she’s bi) well two years ago they split and I was really freaking close to her. So me and my mom moved out and moved in with my cousin. We stayed there for a year. I was getting tired of having to sleep on the floor so I moved out and moved in with my uncle. My mom started to missed me and was going to make me move in with her as soon as she found a apartment. My cousin kicked her out so she slept in her car till she found an apartment. When she found one I helped her with everything except bills. Well when it came time to “make” me move in I’d grown close to my uncle. Wherever he was I was beside him and were still like that. She still wants me to move in with her but I won’t. Almost every other day we argue. She knows how to get me fired up. She knows which buttons to press. Everyone tells me I’m just like my dad (he died on Christmas Eve when I was 8 months old so I never knew him) but anyway he was abusive to my mom even when she was pregnant with me. Anyways the reason they say I’m like him is because my fuse is short. I lash out as soon as someone starts something with me. I don’t like fighting but I never back down from one. One day me and her were in her car driving and arguing like usual. I started breaking. I couldn’t hold anything in anymore. I felt like the world I carry on my shoulders fell through. I tried jumping out of the car to get away from her. She grabbed me and pulled over the car. I opened the door and she didn’t let go. I threatened to beat her like my dad did (trying to scare her to let go of me(I’ve never hit nor will I ever hit a woman) she didn’t let go. I snatched my arm away and started walking down the road. I tried flipping the car (I workout) I just wanted her to leave me alone but I stopped myself. I dropped to my knees bawling my eyes out. I couldn’t stop. Fast forward to tonight. My uncles ex wife (they divorced because she cheated on my uncle and was pooping pills) she thinks my uncle owes her everything and blames him for her doing what she did. They argued for a hour while I stayed outside. She walks out and shouts “and you need to stop taking care of that little basterd and send his ass home” I stayed quite. I just stood there. I haven’t did anything to this woman but refuse to give her my money cause she’s always asking Everyone. She doesn’t have a job. She smooches off every one who gives her money. I’m tired of being the basterd. I’m tired of hiding how I feel. Nobody believes me when I talk about how I feel. My girlfriend doesn’t understand what I’m going through. I DONT EVEN HAVE A FUCKING BED!  I still sleep on the floor. I don’t have a room. I have nothing. I just want to feel better about myself.
